suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require documented nephrolithiasis preceding separately documented CKD. This is population-level risk evidence and does not establish individual causation. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Kidney Stones (Nephrolithiasis) and Chronic Kidney Disease / Renal Failure
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented nephrolithiasis preceding separately documented CKD. This is population-level risk evidence and does not establish individual causation.
